Architecture Overview

Understanding the technical architecture of RoselineMCP.

System Architecture

MCP Client (Claude, etc.)
    ↓ stdio (JSON-RPC)
MCP Server Layer
    ↓ Tool Registration
Tools Layer ([McpServerTool])
    ↓ Dependency Injection
Service Layer (Business Logic)
    ↓
External Dependencies (Roslyn, MSBuild)

Core Components

MCP Server Layer

  • Handles MCP protocol communication
  • Auto-discovers tools via reflection
  • Manages stdio transport

Tools Layer

  • Static methods with [McpServerTool] attribute
  • Receives services via DI
  • Returns JSON responses

Service Layer

  • SolutionAnalyzerService: Solution analysis
  • CodeFixService: Automated fixes
  • DiagnosticFilterService: Filtering logic
  • MSBuildService: Workspace management

Design Patterns

Dependency Injection

All services registered as singletons:

services.AddSingleton<ISolutionAnalyzerService, SolutionAnalyzerService>();

Workspace Isolation

Each operation creates a new workspace to prevent conflicts.

Error Resilience

All tools catch exceptions and return JSON errors.

Data Flow

  1. Client sends MCP request
  2. Server routes to tool method
  3. Tool calls service layer
  4. Service performs operations
  5. Results serialized to JSON
  6. Response sent to client

Performance Considerations

  • Workspace caching for repeated operations
  • Lazy loading of analyzers
  • Streaming for large results
  • Parallel project analysis

Security

  • No code execution from analyzed projects
  • Temporary workspace isolation
  • Path validation
  • Read-only operations by default
